visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man wearing a dark blue baseball cap with a white logo and a plain beige t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen. He holds up a foldable smartphone towards the camera, pointing his left index finger at the screen which displays a high-resolution portrait of a different man. The background is slightly out of focus, showing dark kitchen cabinets and stainless steel appliances under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to a direct screen capture of the man's smartphone. The screen displays an image of a celebrity-looking man with a neutral expression. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese are visible at the bottom of the frame. (3) Back to the man in the kitchen, who is now speaking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. He gestures toward himself and the camera while talking. A small black wireless microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. (4) A large green logo with the word "FLAI" in a stylized font appears in the center of the screen as a graphic overlay. Below it, the text "FLAI 是你的任意門" is displayed in a matching green font. (5) The man is shown looking down at his phone, his thumb tapping the screen. He is wearing a silver-colored watch with a blue dial on his left wrist. (6) An interface overlay appears, showing a chat screen with a blue background and white text bubbles containing a conversation in Traditional Chinese. A small circular profile icon is visible next to the AI's messages. (7) The man looks up at the camera with a wide, surprised smile and begins to laugh heartily, holding his phone in his right hand. A yellow question mark graphic flashes briefly near his head to emphasize his confusion. (8) A rapid montage of cooking actions: hands in white disposable gloves pipe a brown paste onto green leafy vegetables; a thick piece of meat tied with twine is seared in a frying pan on a gas stove; and a rich, dark gravy is spooned over a plated steak dish with garnish. (9) The man stands in the kitchen holding his phone, showing the camera a long block of text on the screen. He looks impressed and continues to talk energetically. (10) A close-up of the man's face as he takes a bite of the cooked food using a black fork. He chews and nods, showing a positive reaction with a squinted-eye smile. (11) The man faces the camera again, pointing with both hands toward the bottom of the frame as if directing the viewer to a link. He maintains a friendly and persuasive facial expression. (12) The video concludes with the green "FLAI" logo appearing again over a blurred, white background.
